mentions.name: Mobile multiplexer app
mentions.description: A mobile multiplexer app with good scrolling, good composing, simple hotkey use, file sharing, and many quality-of-life features; the builder has used it daily on the go for about two months and is working through a setback after investing in the older herdr-tui protocol, which herdr has since moved away from.
mentions.problem: Every existing mobile multiplexer tried was either too old-fashioned or low quality.
mentions.source_excerpt:
2. I'm building a mobile multiplexer because every one I tried was either too old-fashioned or low quality.

Now I've built a great app with good scrolling, good composing, simple use of hotkeys, file sharing, and many, many QoL features. I'm really using it on the go almost daily across two months now.
mentions.author: brachkow
